instruction: Pick up the bowls on the counter and stack them on top of one another in the open cabinet. Place the smaller bowl on top of the larger bowl.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: one of the two bowls is inside the open cabinet and the gripper is no longer touching it.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: neither bowl is inside the cabinet yet (still held, on the counter, or only partly inside).

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: both bowls are inside the cabinet, one bowl is nested inside the other, and the gripper has moved away from both (about 25 cm or more).
stage_definitions.does_not_count: a bowl is still outside the cabinet or still held, the bowls sit side by side instead of stacked, or the gripper is still at a bowl.
